Title: UX/UI/feature-gap audit — 26-agent swarm (718?170 findings)
Notes: Full report: docs/product/UX-AUDIT.md. 26 agents (15 screen + 9 dimension + synthesis + critic). 718 raw ? 170 deduped findings · 13 themes · 14 quick wins · Top-30 (ALT-178..207) · 27 missing capabilities (ALT-208..214) · quick-wins batch (ALT-215). Owner to REVIEW and pick the launch-with items before any build.

Title: Bulk-action bars on all lists (multiselect only Exports today)
Notes: High severity · effort L · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #1. Shared SelectionActionBar when sel>0: bulk status/stage change, reassign, approve, login-provision. Needs new batch endpoints (data layer is single-record today).

Title: One global toast + confirmation system
Notes: High severity · effort M · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #2. No app-wide toast; only one window.confirm in whole app. ToastProvider (auto-dismiss, success/error/info, aria-live) + branded ConfirmDialog routed through all write paths. Unlocks dozens of downstream findings. ? DONE 2026-06-21: ToastProvider/useToast + ConfirmProvider/useConfirm built and mounted at App root (src/components/ui/Toast.tsx + ConfirmDialog.tsx). Now used by the launch-safety wiring; remaining pages migrate to it incrementally.

Title: Confirm every destructive / irreversible action
Notes: High severity · effort M · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #3. Clinch, confirm/cancel meeting, request-approval, approve, disable user/project, unassign, convert all fire on one click with no guard/undo. SHIP WITH LAUNCH. ? DONE 2026-06-21: confirm wired on cancel-meeting, approve-report (Approvals + inline ReportTab), request-approval (locks form), disable-user, disable-project, remove-member, convert-to-lead, and now clinch/close (mark-successful). Irreversible actions guarded by the branded ConfirmDialog + toast feedback.

Title: Restore a visible keyboard focus indicator app-wide
Notes: High severity · effort S · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #4. index.css strips outline from every control — WCAG 2.4.7 fail. Add global :focus-visible ring + brand ring on form controls. ? DONE 2026-06-21: global :focus-visible brand ring restored in index.css (was stripping outline from every control).

Title: Make table rows + sortable headers keyboard-operable
Notes: High severity · effort M · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #5. Rows are onClick on non-focusable <tr>; headers no role/aria-sort. NotificationsPage already does it right — replicate. ? DONE 2026-06-21: all 5 lists — data rows keyboard-operable (role=link, tabIndex, Enter/Space opens) and sortable headers get role=button + aria-sort + Enter/Space-to-sort.

Title: Searchable multi-select filters (replace single-select dropdowns)
Notes: High severity · effort M · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #6. Every facet is a native single <select> over hundreds of options. SearchSelect combobox already exists but used in zero filters. Multi-select + chips + set.has() predicates. ? DONE 2026-06-21 (owner #1 ask): reusable MultiSelectFilter (searchable popover + checkboxes + chip count, OR-within-facet, empty=all) now on ALL FIVE lists — Leads (Agent/Project/City/Source/Industry/Stage), Contacts (Company/City), Companies (Industry/City), Meetings (Agent/Industry/City/Salesperson/Status), Wishlist (Status/Agent/TeamLead/Industry/City). Separate follow-up: per-column/advanced operators (Top#7, ALT-184).

Title: Advanced / per-column filtering + missing core facets
Notes: High severity · effort L · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #7. No contains/is-empty/AND-OR; customizer-added columns un-filterable. Missing facets: Account Status/Demo/Size/Owner/date on Companies; Contact Status; Meeting Mode+Confirmed; Wishlist Unassigned.

Title: Saved views capturing filters+sort+density (multiple, named)
Notes: High severity · effort M · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #8. user_view_pref has a name column but saveView persists only columns + one anonymous slot. Extend to {columns,filters,sorting,pageSize,density} + view picker (save-as/rename/delete).

Title: Persist list/detail state (filters, sort, page, tab) in the URL
Notes: High severity · effort M · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #9. All state is React-only; refresh/back/share resets the worklist. Serialize to query params; sync active tab + projectId on detail pages. ?? IN PROGRESS 2026-06-21: useUrlState/useUrlString/useUrlNumber/useUrlStringArray hooks built (src/lib/useUrlState.ts, on react-router useSearchParams); dashboard drill-downs already deep-link /leads?stage=. Remaining: wire list filters/sort/page/tab to the URL.

Title: "Select all N matching" across pages (not just current page)
Notes: Medium severity · effort M · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #10. Header checkbox toggles only the visible page; partial off-page selection silently scopes Export. Add "Select all N matching" banner.

Title: Global search / Cmd-K command palette
Notes: High severity · effort L · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #11. No global search anywhere. Cmd/Ctrl-K across leads/companies/contacts/meetings by name/number/phone with deep-link navigation. ? DONE 2026-06-21: global Cmd/Ctrl-K CommandPalette across leads/companies/contacts (keyboard nav + deep-link) + TopBar Search button. Notes: High severity · effort L · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #12. Contacts + Approvals are hand-rolled; others use TanStack — divergent headers/row-heights/sort-glyphs and every fix built 3×. One <DataTable> + shared spec.

Title: Dirty-state navigation guard on all forms/modals
Notes: High severity · effort M · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #13. No form tracks dirty; Cancel/back/tab-switch/backdrop silently discards edits. Track isDirty + useBlocker + beforeunload + modal-close guard. Worst for ReportTab (~20 fields). ?? Notes: High severity · effort L · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #14. Every list downloads the full dataset + lookups on mount; Contacts capped at 1000. Push to Supabase range+filters or cache; remove the 1000 cap.

Title: Role-aware, actionable dashboard ("what do I do today")
Notes: High severity · effort L · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #15. Dashboard never calls useAuth; same org-wide all-time totals for everyone. Scope to current user, add "my meetings today / follow-ups due / leads needing first contact", TL/ADMIN rollups.

Title: Clickable dashboard drill-downs (cards/bars/activity rows)
Notes: High severity · effort M · UX-AUDIT Top-30 #16. All stat cards, stage bars, activity rows are static (some even fake a hover). Wire each to the filtered list / record. ? DONE 2026-06-21: top-level ErrorBoundary at app root (Reload / Go to dashboard fallback; DEV-only stack). RouteErrorBoundary helper available for per-route use.
